تختطفون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَطِفُونَ (taḵtaṭifūna) /tax.ta.tˤi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# تُخْتَطَفُونَ (tuḵtaṭafūna) /tux.ta.tˤa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
